title: AI agent: latency, tokens and cost from @ai-sdk/otel
description: gen_ai.client.inference.duration from @ai-sdk/otel, plus token usage and list-price cost, for an AI SDK agent on two models.

options.content:
### An AI agent, measured with the AI SDK's own OpenTelemetry metric
A small on-call helper agent built on the [AI SDK](https://ai-sdk.dev) answers questions about a shop with two tools. It runs around the clock on two models through the Gemini API free tier: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and the open-weights Gemma 4 26B. Latency comes from `gen_ai.client.inference.duration`, the histogram [@ai-sdk/otel](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ai-sdk/otel) records for every model call. I asked for it in [vercel/ai#24229](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/24229) and it shipped in @ai-sdk/otel 1.0.160. Tokens come from the semconv `gen_ai.client.token.usage` histogram. Cost is tokens times each model's list price, so it shows what this traffic would cost on the paid tier. Gemma has no paid price, so its cost is zero. Prices as of November 3, 2026.

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Calls to a model in the last hour, every outcome.

panels.title: p95 inference latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of gen_ai.client.inference.duration over the last hour, all models.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens in the last hour.

panels.title: Cost at list price
panels.description: Last hour of tokens times list price per model.

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
))

panels.title: Calls that failed
panels.description: Share of model calls the histogram recorded with error.type set (timeouts, rate limits, server errors).

panels.title: p50 and p95 inference latency by model
panels.description: Successful calls only, rolling 15 minutes. The p95 line is dashed.

panels.title: Where model calls land, by bucket
panels.description: Every call, both models, in the histogram's own bucket boundaries (0.01 s to 81.92 s).

panels.title: Tokens per minute, input and output
panels.description: From gen_ai.client.token.usage, recorded once per model call.

panels.title: Cost per hour at list price
panels.description: Rolling one-hour token cost per model. List prices in prices.json next to this dashboard.

targets.expr:
sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
)

panels.title: Tokens per model call (average)
panels.description: Tool results make input grow with each step of a run.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_count[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost per agent run
panels.description: One-hour cost divided by runs finished in that hour.

targets.expr:
sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(agent_runs_total[1h]))

panels.title: Doing what it was asked, within budget
Runs that passed each check
panels.description: Rolling one hour. used_required_tools: the run called every tool its question needs. answered: the reply is not empty. on_topic: the reply names what was asked about.

panels.title: Required tools used, by model and task
panels.description: Rolling six hours. Shows which model skips a tool on which kind of question.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, agent_task) (increase(agent_task_checks_total{check="used_required_tools", result="pass"}[6h])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model, agent_task) (increase(agent_task_checks_total{check="used_required_tools"}[6h]))

panels.title: Spend in the last 24 hours, share of daily budget
panels.description: Last 24 hours of tokens at list price against a $1.00 daily budget.

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[24h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[24h])) * 2.5e-06)
)) / 1.0

panels.title: Projected spend per day
panels.description: Last hour of cost times 24.

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
)) * 24

panels.description: One run is a question answered with up to four model calls. One run in ten gets a 1.5 s deadline on purpose.

panels.description: The inference histogram records failed calls too, with error.type set.

panels.description: get_error_rate and get_runbook.
